title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carson Beck (back) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Carson Beck was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Beck has been dealing with back spasms. He remains the current No. 3 quarterback for the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Walter Nolen III (ankle) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Walter Nolen III did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nolen did not play in Week 7 against the Broncos. He could be on track to miss another game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Love has missed the past couple weeks of action. His return to open the week gives him a chance to return on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jack Jones released by 49ers
items.desc: The 49ers released Jack Jones.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity. He was released to create room on the roster for DeForest Buckner.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Myles Garrett will not be designated to return from injured reserve this week.
items.impact: Garrett remains week-to-week. He has been sidelined since Week 1 with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will not return to practice this week
items.desc: Rams coach Sean McVay said Terrance Ferguson will not be designated to return from injured reserve this week.
items.impact: Ferguson remains without a clear timetable to return. Tyler Higbee and Colby Parkinson will continue to lead a committee of tight ends.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Parkinson has played a bigger role in recent weeks. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nate Landman (concussion) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nate Landman was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Landman remains in concussion protocol.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trent McDuffie (groin) returns to practice
items.desc: Trent McDuffie returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: This was McDuffie's first practice since he injured his groin during a Week 6 practice. He was limited in his return.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jaylin Noel (toe) placed on IR
items.desc: Jaylin Noel (toe) has been placed on IR due to his turf toe injury.
items.impact: Noel suffered the injury in the Texans Week 7 loss to the Giants. He will miss a minimum of four games. Marvin Harrison Jr., Tank Dell, and Kayshon Boutte will all see a slight bump in work with Noel out, with the primary beneficiary likely Dell.
